title: Insider describes place where bodies are stored

tellings.quote: One of them has talked about a place in which bodies are stored where they stored.

plain: A UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that he has heard from unnamed former military and intelligence insiders. According to him, one of them has talked about a place where bodies are stored, by which he means bodies of non-human beings, though he does not say where it is. If true, it would mean the government holds physical remains of non-human beings.
